text:
anya_csm: Quick sync at 11:30 to start Aperture Health onboarding 15m to align owners, must-have success metrics, timeline, and renewal watch. Who can make it?
matt_pm: I'm good for 11:30. I'll own product acceptance & final sign-off.
sophia_enable: I'll run the enablement/demo. Suggested success criteria: end-to-end request flow, sample embedding fidelity checks, Console access for ops, and a short feedback survey.
raj_se: I'll upload sample payloads and small load script. Note: customer requests EU data residency; confirm if pilot needs EU infra.
dave_eng: EU residency for GA yes; pilot can run in hosted with geo-tagging, but if they want Private EU, that's ~3w. Also SSO is GA-only; token auth for pilot. I'll add SSO task.
anya_csm: Timeline: smoke tests within 48h, internal pilot 5 business days, customer pilot in 12 days. Renewal flag: renewal window ~11 months; we'll start usage reporting month 1 to build value narrative.
matt_pm: Action items: @raj_se -> samples + README to s3://aperture/samples by 10am tomorrow; @dave_eng -> confirm EU infra feasibility and SSO ETA in JIRA; @sophia_enable -> schedule 30m enablement + create 4-question feedback form. I'll draft acceptance checklist.
sophia_enable: Scheduling now. Plan: 15m demo + 15m Qs. Survey link posted post-demo. I'll include a quick Ops checklist in Confluence.
calendar-bot: Event created: "Aperture Health onboarding - welcome" at 11:30. Attendees: anya_csm, matt_pm, sophia_enable, raj_se, dave_eng.
raj_se: Uploaded samples and README with curl/python examples to s3://aperture/samples. README includes a minimal canary traffic pattern (10 rps) for pilot.
dave_eng: Logged risks: "EU_residency_delay" and "SSO_delay". Fallbacks: hosted EU tag or token auth for pilot. Also adding: on-call escalation path for pilot.
anya_csm: Draft acceptance checklist (will formalize in Confluence):
```
- smoke_tests: pass
- p95_latency < 350ms
- embedding_spotcheck >= 0.9
- console_access: granted
- eu_data_tagging: configured if required
- first_week_usage_reported
```
matt_pm: Also capture cost baseline and monitoring alerts before pilot. If EU infra needed, note impact to timeline and cost.
sophia_enable: After demo I'll post a 1-paragraph summary + survey link here. We'll run daily 10m standups for the first 5 business days to triage issues and gather feedback.
anya_csm: Great. I'll send a 1-pager to the exec sponsor and kick off the standup series. Thanks team :rocket:
